intro: Technology and government sectors bore the brunt of 34 zero-day vulnerabilities documented between April 12 and August 4, 2026, with critical and high-severity cases dominating the mix. APT29, Chaotic Eclipse, and Claude Mythos were observed in campaigns spanning Global, Asia, China, Europe, and North America. The most severe flaw, CVE-2026-22679, carries a CVSS score of 9.8, followed by CVE-2026-34621 at 8.6, CVE-2026-3502 at 7.8, CVE-2026-32183 at 7.5, and CVE-2026-32201 at 6.5. Telecommunications, critical infrastructure, and enterprise networks also faced exposure across the reporting period.
